param_input_item.param_description: figure created with uifigure, or figure graphics object.
property name: a scalar string or row vector character.
property value: a value compatible with property name.

description.p: lbl = uilabel creates a label in a new figure and returns the Label object. Nelson calls the uifigure function to create the figure.
lbl = uilabel(parent) creates the label in the specified parent container.

lbl = uilabel(..., propertyName, propertyValue) specifies label properties as one or more name-value arguments: Text, Interpreter, HorizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment, WordWrap, FontName, FontSize, FontWeight, FontAngle, FontColor, BackgroundColor, Enable, Visible, Tooltip, Position, ...

example_item.example_item_description: Captured UI component for the help image.
